body.text: Which languages does Itinerary of Türkiye's local team and vetted interpreter network cover?

Our two founders manage your planning directly in English and Turkish, while our vetted local interpreter network provides on-site support in Arabic, German, French, Russian, Spanish, Mandarin, and Japanese for private tours, business meetings, and non-clinical hospital coordination across Türkiye.

Clear communication matters most when schedules combine leisure, corporate meetings, and healthcare visits. Unlike commission-based agencies that assign unvetted clinic staff to translate, [Itinerary of Türkiye](https://itineraryofturkiye.com/) matches you with independent, sworn, or medically experienced interpreters who answer to you. For clinical visits, our coordinators also help you navigate official patient support channels such as the [Ministry of Health and USHAŞ 24/7 International Health Services Call Center](https://shgmturizmdb.saglik.gov.tr/EN-90754/international-health-services-call-center-commences-service.html) (+90 850 288 38 38), which operates in six languages. We coordinate your visit. Your licensed medical team makes clinical decisions.
How do visa, currency and flight logistics differ for UK, EU, US, Gulf and Asian visitors?

Entry rules, direct flight times, and payment habits vary significantly by region, yet every foreign visitor must hold a passport valid for at least 60 days beyond their permitted stay and plan around Turkish Lira pricing alongside international card acceptance.

Thanks to [Istanbul Airport's global network](https://www.istairport.com/en/corporate/istanbul-airport-the-worlds-most-connected-airport?locale=en) serving 128+ countries via 180+ airlines, reaching Türkiye is straightforward, though entry formalities depend on your passport. Always confirm your exact status on the [Ministry of Foreign Affairs visa portal](https://www.mfa.gov.tr/visa-information-for-foreigners.en.mfa) and review the [60-day passport validity rule](https://www.mfa.gov.tr/general-information-about-turkish-visas.en.mfa) before departure.

body.text: How does a single flat-fee local partner coordinate leisure, medical and business needs together?

A single flat-fee local partner synchronizes airport VIP meet-and-greet, recovery-friendly hotels, vetted multilingual interpreters, executive transfers, and private cultural excursions on one unified timeline, completely removing the scheduling friction and hidden commission markups of juggling separate tour operators and clinic coordinators.

Global visitors often combine a dental, ophthalmic, or preventive check-up with family sightseeing or executive meetings in Istanbul, Izmir, or Antalya. Through our [medical tourism coordination service](https://itineraryofturkiye.com/services/medical-tourism), we verify that any facility you consider holds a [Ministry of Health International Health Tourism Authorization Certificate](https://shgmturizmdb.saglik.gov.tr/EN-69289/healthcare-providers-with-international-health-tourism-authorization-certificates.html) and align plans with safety guidance from the [U.S. Embassy in Türkiye](https://tr.usembassy.gov/medical-tourism/). Run directly by our two founders—see our [About page](https://itineraryofturkiye.com/about)—we stay objective: Paid by our clients. Independent of provider commissions. We sequence sightseeing before procedures and build flexible buffers for follow-up clearance.
What should you include (and leave out) in your first enquiry?

In your first enquiry, share your approximate travel dates, party size, language preferences, cities of interest, and general trip purpose, while leaving out sensitive documents such as passport scans, medical records, or credit card details until a secure workflow is established.
Use this checklist to prepare a clear, privacy-safe initial message:

items: Include your travel window and flexibility: Mention target months, total nights, and arrival airport preferences.
Include group composition and mobility needs: Note ages, accessibility needs, and companion recovery preferences.
Include language requirements: Specify which languages you need for drivers, guides, or appointments.
Include broad itinerary goals: State if you are blending leisure, business meetings, or general medical logistics.
Leave out sensitive files: Do not attach passport or ID scans, clinical records, diagnostic imaging, or payment details.

faq.q: Which languages can Itinerary of Türkiye arrange for medical and travel support?
faq.a: Our two founders work directly in English and Turkish, and our vetted local interpreter network covers Arabic, German, French, Russian, Spanish, and major East Asian languages for hospital appointments and private tours.

faq.q: Does Itinerary of Türkiye provide medical advice or choose my treatment?
faq.a: No. We coordinate your visit. Your licensed medical team makes clinical decisions. We handle logistics, vetted hospital-grade interpreters, recovery hotels, and airport transfers without taking clinic commissions.

faq.q: Do UK, EU, US, and Gulf citizens need a visa for Türkiye in 2026?
faq.a: Visa rules depend on passport nationality. Many UK, EU, US, and GCC ordinary passport holders qualify for visa-free entry or e-Visa access, but every traveler should verify current rules on the Ministry of Foreign Affairs website before booking.

faq.q: How long must my passport be valid to enter Türkiye?
faq.a: Under Article 7.1b of Law No. 6458, your passport must remain valid for at least 60 days beyond the duration of stay granted by your visa, e-Visa, or visa exemption.

faq.q: How can I verify that a Turkish clinic is authorized for international patients?
faq.a: Check that the facility holds an International Health Tourism Authorization Certificate issued by the Republic of Türkiye Ministry of Health before paying any clinical deposit.

faq.q: What personal documents should I avoid sending in my first enquiry?
faq.a: Never send passport or ID scans, medical records, lab reports, or payment details in your initial message. Share only your target dates, city preferences, language needs, and general trip goals.
